counterexamples: Results and their order are unchanged.

defects.evidence: async_fetch.py _bounded creates a new Semaphore(limit) per key, so no two requests share one.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Create one semaphore in fetch_all and share it.
defects.impact: Every request runs at once; the concurrency bound no longer protects the upstream service.
defects.match_criteria: Identify that the semaphore is no longer shared across requests, or that the limit is not enforced.
defects.trigger: fetch_all is called with more keys than limit.
